title: Cosmic Ruin Portal
description: A crumbling stone archway with glowing blue stained glass stands on rocky ground to the left. A massive swirling golden-yellow cosmic vortex erupts in the center, surrounded by glowing fragments and particles against a dark starry nebula sky.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene featuring an ancient crumbling stone archway with glowing blue stained glass on the left side of a rocky terrain. A massive swirling golden vortex of light and cosmic energy explodes from the center, breaking apart into glowing golden fragments and particles that float in the air. Dramatic dark blue starry nebula sky fills the background with deep clouds and distant stars, epic and mystical atmosphere, cinematic lighting.
